one_line: A top-down, hands-only page flip in one steady take, ending on the back cover with the child's photo and name.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down close-up: a hand tilts a glossy hardcover; 0:01 a toddler-superhero cover with the child's name. Voiceover from 0:00.7 (transcript): "טוב תקשיבו, אני מתרגשת ברמות מהחבילה שקיבלנו". Subtitle "טוב תקשיבו," at 0:01.
q1_hook.why: The book is in a moving hand from the first frame and a voice starts by 0:01 (S1, S4, H1). The line is excitement about a parcel, not a promise, so the value, a book for her son, lands at 0:05 (H2). The subtitle starts at 0:01 (H6); nothing is written at 0:00 (T3).

beats.what: A hand tilts a hardcover: a birthday-themed cover, then a toddler-superhero cover; "טוב תקשיבו,"
beats.why: The finished product first, in a hand

beats.what: The book opens: a boy at a door, then a toddler in a purple cape; "ברמות", "באמת"
beats.why: Shows the child as the hero on the first pages

beats.what: A spotlight spread, the hero in a cape; "שהוא", "של", "בAi"
beats.why: A new picture, and how the book is made

beats.what: Spreads with an old woman with bags and a cat; "מושלם.", "זה משהו שאני יכולה"
beats.why: Story pages show the book is a full story

beats.what: A boy with the cat in a garden; "לשמור לו", "החיים."
beats.why: The keepsake line, the emotional centre

beats.what: Two boys laughing, then a boy with a backpack; "אפשר לבחור", "את פשוט יוצרת ספר על הילד"
beats.why: Choice of story and how simple it is

beats.what: The glossy back cover: a round baby photo, the name, a logo; "רוצי להזמין אחותי,", "פינקתי אותך,", "קוד"
beats.why: The real photo last, then the ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None: no question, tag, save or send ask. The only ask is to order with a coupon code (spoken, subtitled, in the caption).
q2_flow.why: A page turns every 2 to 3 s, so each beat is a new illustration (R3, F8). "Not just a gift, something to keep for life" gives the flip a feeling (K4, K1). The real photo on the back cover is a held-back payoff (R4), and it ends right after the ask (R1).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled 0:26 to 0:29: "רוצי להזמין אחותי, פינקתי אותך, קוד"; the code itself is not in the sampled frames. Caption: "קוד קופון alma10". No link, no comment word.
q3_cta.why: One action, order with a code, said and written at the end after the book is shown (C1, C6). The code itself is only in the caption, whose first line is a feeling, not the ask (C6). A coupon with no link means the viewer must search for the brand.

q4_shown.what: A hardcover held and tilted (0:00); a top-down page flip of the child as a cartoon hero in scenes (0:03 to 0:26), a birthday-cake cover under it throughout; the glossy back cover with a round baby photo and name (0:27). No price.
q4_shown.why: The product is handled from 0:00 (S1, S4). Pages show the child as hero in many scenes (S8), and the back cover shows a real photo with the name for about 2 s (S2, F4), but photo and illustration never share a frame. A baby's photo with his name is the combination S5 warns against.

q5_edit.what: About 5 shots in 29 s; one locked-off take of about 24 s whose only cuts are page turns; word-by-word subtitles change every 1 to 2 s; ends on the back cover, no end card.
q5_edit.why: A steady take lets a viewer look at each page, and the page turns plus subtitles give the pulse (R3, E2). Subtitles stay short and change often (E4, T2). It ends on the back cover and the ask with no tail (E8, R1), and 29 s suits a flip-through (R2).

q6_topic.what: A mother shows the personalised hero book made for her baby son, a keepsake, with a coupon to order. Serves parents and relatives looking for a personal gift.
q6_topic.why: A birthday-themed book and "not just a gift, something I can keep for him for life" tie it to a buying moment and a feeling (K7, K1). Her first-person excitement is the voucher (S6). The point, a keepsake, is clear, with no developmental claim (K4).

q7_filmed.what: A top-down handheld close-up of a hand turning the pages of a hardcover, a white feather decoration and a dark vase filling the top third, soft indoor light; some glare on the glossy back cover. No face.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on a large, clear page put the viewer in the reader's seat (S4, F5), and the illustration fills the frame (F4). A home look, no studio (H8, F7). The feather and vase fill the top third with clutter, and subtitles sit low over the pages (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Small white bold subtitles, no box, one to three words at a time, changing every 1 to 2 s, at about 85% of the frame height: "טוב תקשיבו," (0:01), "ברמות" (0:03), "באמת" (0:07), "מושלם." (0:15), "זה משהו שאני יכולה" (0:17), "אפשר לבחור" (0:21), "רוצי להזמין אחותי," (0:26), "קוד" (0:28). No headline card, no brand text; the cover shows the child's name.
q8_text.caption: "איזה כייף שאפשר ליצור ספרים בAi📚". About 20 words: a delight line, a discount line, "קוד קופון alma10", and "בשיתוף @mebook.ai" last. No hashtags, no question.
q8_text.why: Short subtitles in step with the voice let a muted viewer follow (T1, T2), but they sit at about 85% of the frame, in the bottom 35%, in thin white over busy art (T4, T5). The caption has the code and the disclosure line, but no hashtags (T7, T8).

weak_points: Subtitles in the bottom 15% over busy art; a mild opener with no promise; a baby photo with his name on the back cover; the code only in the caption; Ai wording, which LumeBook should not copy.
lumebook_takeaway: Top-down phone shot of your hands flipping the real book in one take, finishing on the back cover and one CTA. No child needed.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's own; music (cannot hear); the code in the last second (0:28 to 0:29 not sampled; the transcript hears it garbled); the book titles and price. Correction to src/coded: two books appear, a birthday-themed cover lies under the flipping book throughout and is the first cover seen at 0:00; the first subtitle is at 0:01, so no text sits in the first frame.
